name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🚪 Entrances on every hive: the front (open, reduced on the reducer's big or small notch, or closed), the inner cover's notch (down or up, front or back) and a back entrance. A mouse guard or robbing screen goes on the front.
👀 The hive picture is from the back, so the front entrance shows in its own strip under it, as you'd see it standing in front.
🍯 The feeder on the hive: top, jar or pail, bag, candy board, pollen patty, frame (1 or 2 frames) or a Boardman at the entrance. The Feeding form fills in from it ("Filled it").
⚠️ A feeder and a super together asks: take one off, or "no flow on, they're drawing comb". Pollen patties never ask.
🪵 Quilt boxes (with a spring reminder to take them off) and shims, including Imirie shims with their own entrance.
